widgets_values: The camera slowly circles a small paved square in an old town at dusk after rain, where a man in a dark overcoat stands still in the middle, surrounded by four tall stone townhouses.

The target video is a photoreal, naturally lit city film in the look of a quiet European drama, shot on a 35 mm lens with soft contrast, gentle film grain and the cool blue hour just after sunset, the sky a pale steel blue fading to warm peach above the rooftops. Rain has just stopped, so the square is damp and its paving holds thin puddles that mirror the sky and the first lit windows. [Shot 1] A man of about forty in a long charcoal wool overcoat, dark trousers and leather shoes stands alone and still in the centre of a small square paved with worn grey granite setts, hands in his pockets, looking ahead. The camera circles him slowly at a steady distance and a little above head height, so the buildings around the square turn past behind him while he stays in the middle of the frame. Four townhouses of pale limestone and ochre render stand around the far side of the square, two of four storeys and two of six, with tall shuttered windows, wrought-iron balconies, carved stone cornices and slate roofs. Their ground floors hold a bakery with its striped awning rolled in, a closed bookshop with stacked volumes behind the glass and a small cafe whose warm tungsten light spills across the wet stone. Old cast-iron street lamps at the corners of the square glow amber, each throwing a soft pool onto the paving and a long reflection across the puddles. Upper windows glow yellow and blue from rooms inside, and narrow lanes lead away between the buildings into darkness. Wet cobbles catch the lamplight in long streaks, a bicycle leans against a railing outside the cafe, and potted bay trees stand on either side of the bookshop door. A few late pigeons lift from a ledge, thin wisps of steam rise from a grate near the kerb, and rainwater drips steadily from a gutter onto the stones. The man's breath is faintly visible in the cold air and his coat stirs a little in the breeze; the camera keeps moving smoothly around him with a slight handheld sway, and the square stays quiet and empty apart from him for the whole shot.
Dripping gutters, a light evening breeze, distant footsteps and a faint tram bell.
